$comment: Permission allowlist for one headless fixture-v1 baseline run. Copied verbatim to $RUN_ROOT/repo/.claude/settings.json by runner.sh, which then adds the pinned plugin marketplace to the same file with --scope project. The run itself passes --permission-mode bypassPermissions, so this list is the record of what a delivery of the bench binder is expected to need, not the only thing standing between the run and the machine.
